usedFor: SprintOps holds tasks and sprints, and Google Calendar receives events through “Create Calendar Event” when a task is assigned.

bestTemplate.name: “When a task is assigned” in SprintOps, then “Create Calendar Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: An assigned task becomes a calendar event with time, duration, attendees and meeting details.

watchOut: “When a task is updated” runs on every update, so “Create Calendar Event” can add the same event repeatedly.
